title: Story: directions, the chosen one, beats
judge_notes: A short video story (usually 15-60 s). Judge the chosen direction and its beats; the other directions only need to be real alternatives.

questions.text: Does story.md have the sections Directions, Chosen and Beats?
Does story.md offer 2 or 3 genuinely different directions, each in 1-3 sentences?
questions.evidence: Quote the first words of each direction.

questions.text: Does the Chosen section say why this direction beats the others for the brief's audience and goal?
Does the story open with a hook a viewer understands with the sound off in the first 3 seconds?
Is every product claim in the story found in research.md's claims list?
questions.evidence: Quote each claim and the research claim it comes from.

questions.text: Is there one clear main character with a problem the audience recognises from research.md?
Does every beat carry a time range, and do the beats add up to the brief's length?
questions.evidence: Quote the first and last time ranges.

questions.text: Does the product do something visible on screen, not only get talked about?
questions.evidence: Quote the beat where it is seen.

questions.text: Does the story end on the brief's call to action?
questions.evidence: Quote the last beat and the brief's call to action.

questions.text: Can every beat be filmed as 1-3 s shots of one small action each (no crowds, no stunts, nobody leaving frame)?
questions.evidence: Quote the hardest beat to film.

questions.text: Is the story free of real brands, logos, celebrities and competitors named or shown?
questions.evidence: Name any real brand or person.
